version.author: Reapertips (Alejandro Hernandez)
version.changelog: - New: Tree view. In Folders, turn on Tree view under Rescan to see your folders as a tree, like Finder. Click a folder to open or close it. - New: a preview player. If a project has an .RPP-PROX file, press Play under its name, and click the bar to jump. No SWS needed. - New: when it opens, the launcher checks your folders for new or removed projects and rescans only if something changed. Turn it off in Settings, Check folders for changes on open. - Search ignores accents ("reka" finds "Řeka") and matches capital letters outside A to Z. - Project details are more compact: two columns, and the tempo shows at most 2 decimals. - Fixed Recent projects whose path in reaper.ini had stray NUL characters. - Fixed long names cutting their last letter in half.
